name: Inferno Style
description:
You are in Inferno Style.

  • Your weapon attacks gain the Cleave Trait if they do not have it already.

  • Cleave Damage you inflict ignores Armor.

  • Your maximum Focus is 3. When you enter Inferno Style, you gain +1 Focus.

  • Build Focus: Once per turn, you may use an Action to gain +1 Focus.

  • Channel the Flames: At the end of your turn, you gain +1 Focus for each of the following:

    • You performed the Charge action.

    • You performed an Attack check against 2 different creatures between now and the end of your last turn.

  • When you make an Attack Check with a Melee or Ranged weapon you may spend up to 3 Focus, before or after rolling to gain +1 bonus Expertise on that check per Focus spent.

  • If you do not spend or gain any Focus during your turn, your Focus decreases by -1 at the end of your turn.

  • If you have 0 Focus at the end of your turn, Inferno Style immediately ends.

  • If you enter another Stance or if you are Incapacitated, Inferno Style immediately ends.

Inferno Style: Channel the Flames at the end of your turn. If you did not spend or gain any Focus during your turn, your Focus decreases by -1. The style ends if you have 0 Focus at the end of your turn.
